**The 2021 loss of 81.3 ha (2.23% of the asset) is corroborated under the run's rule.** The rule needs a later year of the series observed and JRC 2020 agreement on at least 50% of the event area. Both are met.

- **JRC Global Forest Cover 2020:** 98% of the event area was mapped as forest in 2020, so there was tree cover to lose.
